title: Nona di Atas Toren
genre: Ambonese pop ballad with steel guitar
subject: a young woman in Ambon moving into her first kontrakan who finds the house comes with a grey stray cat sleeping on the water tank and a note from the last tenant saying her name is Nona and she likes smoked fish, and slowly the cat becomes hers
caption: Ambonese pop ballad with steel guitar, Maluku pop in the eastern-Indonesian tradition. Hawaiian lap steel guitar with gliding slides, fingerpicked nylon-string acoustic guitar, strummed ukulele, soft round electric bass, gentle brushed drums. Warm intimate production with soft reverb. Warm full female mid-register vocal with Ambon colour and vibrato, clearly sung melody, light harmony in the last chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 78 BPM, D major. Mood of tender settling in. No trap beats, no autotune, no EDM, no hip hop drums, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - lap steel slide, nylon guitar]
[Verse 1]
Beta buka pintu rumah sewa
Kunci baru, lantai penuh debu
Di atas toren ada kucing abu
Dia lihat beta, seng mau turun
[Pre-Chorus]
Di dinding ada surat kecil
Dari orang yang tinggal dulu
[Chorus]
Namanya Nona, dia suka ikan asar
Tolong jaga dia, katanya
Beta baru datang, ose su lama
Mari tinggal sama-sama
[Verse 2]
Malam pertama beta seng tidur
Dengar kaki kecil di atas atap
Pagi-pagi dia di depan pintu
Duduk manis, minta sarapan
[Chorus]
Namanya Nona, dia suka ikan asar
Beta beli dua di pasar
Rumah ini belum rumah beta
Sampai Nona tidur di kaki beta
[Outro - lap steel and ukulele fade]
Nona, Nona
Ose di rumah, beta di rumah
